dedupe_keys.name: ribuild measurements at swiss case building with internal insulation

description: Christoph Geyer and colleagues at Berner Fachhochschule describe measurements from an internally insulated Swiss case-study building in the RIBuild project. Sensors record temperature, relative humidity and electrical resistance as an indirect moisture-content measure at specified locations, with one file per measurement point. Together with other RIBuild cases, these observations support recommendations about internal-insulation systems and their hygrothermal behaviour. The source cites the 2017 MOFEINN monitoring project but does not establish the complete temporal coverage or sampling step. Zenodo exposes descriptive metadata only: access is restricted, and the description directs readers to the named BFH authors for further information. Licence, cost and file formats remain unknown. The related RIBuild historic-building survey provides broader renovation context. A limitation is that the unavailable files prevent verification of sensor placement, completeness and values; no access request or download was made.
